verdict.rationale: Letta offers a local mode that stores agent state on-device without requiring a cloud login, and a self-hosted App Server so operators can run infrastructure entirely under their own control, which implicitly lets users avoid or limit cloud data retention. However, there is no explicit documentation of a deletion API, retention policy, or account/data-erasure mechanism for cloud-backed agents. Missing for 10: explicit data-deletion/erasure commands, documented retention periods, and any GDPR/CCPA-style data control statement.
